Based on Yahoo's internal guidelines, our flexible operating model is called Work@Yahoo. While specific international travel policies often depend on your localized department, the following guidelines govern working outside your normal resident work location:

📍 Working Outside Your Resident State (U.S. Employees Only)
If you are a U.S.-based employee working in a location outside of your resident state for 14 or more days in a calendar year, you must adhere to the following:

Disclose to Payroll: You are required to disclose this information to the Payroll team.

Log in Workday: Document your additional working locations directly in Workday as soon as you reach the 14-day threshold.

Why it matters: Correct reporting ensures that the right state tax jurisdiction is used and correct taxes are withheld. This prevents potential tax audits, significant back-taxes, or penalties for both you and Yahoo.

📌 Key Actions
Keep a record of all locations where you work throughout the calendar year.

Log any new or additional working locations in Workday immediately upon reaching the 14-day mark.

For any international work-from-abroad questions or department-specific compliance, reach out directly to payroll@yahooinc.com or consult the internal Work@Yahoo FAQs.
